trader.name: Claude V2 · Nifty 500 filter off · full-session buying · paper Trader
trader.entry: Completed close above prior 20-session high; prior 50-day average above prior 200-day; non-overlapping prior 10/30 volume ≥ 1.2; Nifty 500 trend filter disabled; completed-session data checks remain required. Rank by 63-session return. Next session only, fresh depth throughout 09:15–15:30 IST while the NSE normal session is open; unfilled signals expire after the session.
trader.exit: Initial stop 2 × Wilder ATR(14) below fill; highest completed close minus 3 × ATR trailing stop, ratchet only from the following session; completed close below prior 50-day average exits next session. No fixed profit target.
trader.risk: 0.5% of current equity at risk including estimated round-trip fees and 0.25% per-side slippage reserve; 3% portfolio heat cap. Existing holdings retain at least their previous protective stop during migration. No daily 2% circuit in original Claude. Existing Trader holdings may use their last valid current-session quote for portfolio valuation when stale. New orders and exits still require fresh prices and depth. Missing, future-dated or prior-session quotes block new buys.
trader.execution: Local depth-limited simulation only. Fresh observed quotes throughout the normal session; never retrospective fills.
trader.entry_window: 09:15–15:30 IST during the connected NSE normal session

investor.name: Fundamentals and trend · paper strategy
investor.entry: Complete annual inputs, no source conflicts, positive PBT/equity and revenue/profit YoY growth, interest coverage ≥ 3 (or reported zero finance costs), net debt/equity ≤ 0.5, and price above the 200-day average. Financial periods/basis/units must agree.
investor.exit: Sell the whole position at a 10% stop or below the 200-day average. Incomplete financial refreshes block new buys; they do not force a sale.
investor.entry_window: 09:15–15:30 IST during the connected NSE normal session
